_comment: Patch manifest for build_manifest_patch.py. One blob (mi_rng.c) and one splice: the
`bsr lcg_rand_next` inside dmr_privacy_key_load_and_mi_draw's MI draw loop becomes a `bsr` to
the blob. See README.md and docs/encryption.md.
name: mi_rng
description: DMR privacy MI from an AES-256 CTR_DRBG seeded from ADC + timer noise, replacing unseeded libc rand().

splices.name: mi_draw
splices.why: Each of the six iterations of the MI fill loop calls lcg_rand_next and stores the low byte (st.b r0,(r5,0) at 0x0305caf0). The caller uses only r0, r4, r5 after the call, and r4/r5 are callee-saved, so a handler that returns the byte in r0 is a drop-in.
